10 An agent uses the Q-learning algorithm to update its Q-table. At
   time step 𝑡:

   Current estimate: 𝑄̂(𝑠𝑡, 𝑎𝑡) = 4.0
   Immediate reward received: 𝑟𝑡+1 = 3.0
   Discount factor: 𝛾= 0.9

  Maximum predicted reward in state 𝑠𝑡+1: 𝑚𝑎𝑥 𝑄̂ (𝑠𝑡+1, 𝑎𝑡+1) =
                                                 𝑎𝑡+1
   10.0

   The new updated estimate for 𝑄̂𝑛𝑒𝑤(𝑠𝑡, 𝑎𝑡) is ____________.
   Answer: 4.8

Refer to Lecture 30: Reinforcement Learning Slide 18


𝑄̂𝑛𝑒𝑤(𝑠𝑡, 𝑎𝑡) = 𝑄̂(𝑠𝑡, 𝑎𝑡) + 𝜂(𝑟𝑡+1 + 𝛾𝑚𝑎𝑥 𝑄̂ (𝑠𝑡+1, 𝑎𝑡+1) −𝑄̂(𝑠𝑡, 𝑎𝑡))
                                            𝑎𝑡+1
       𝑄̂𝑛𝑒𝑤(𝑠𝑡, 𝑎𝑡) = 4.0 + 0.1(3.0 + 0.9 × 10.0 −4.0)
          = 4.0 + 0.1 × 8.0 = 4.8
